classified_spans.text:
## System Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph Edge["Edge Device"]
        A[Mutation Generator]
        B[Isolated Execution Environment]
        C[Mutation Test Runner]
        D[Result Signer]
    end
    subgraph Mutations["Security Mutation Set"]
        M1[Auth Bypass]
        M2[Cert Validation Failure]
        M3[Privilege Escalation]
        M4[API Tampering]
    end
    subgraph Fleet["Neighbor Fleet"]
        N1[Edge Node B]
        N2[Edge Node C]
        N3[Edge Node D]
    end
    subgraph Trust["Trust Evaluation"]
        T1[Trust Score Aggregator]
        T2[Anomaly Detector]
        T3[Quarantine Controller]
    end
    A --> B
    M1 --> B
    M2 --> B
    M3 --> B
    M4 --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D -->|Signed Results| N1
    D -->|Signed Results| N2
    D -->|Signed Results| N3
    N1 -->|Peer Results| T1
    N2 -->|Peer Results| T1
    N3 -->|Peer Results| T1
    T1 --> T2
    T2 -->|Healthy| Fleet
    T2 -->|Anomaly Detected| T3
    T3 -->|Isolate Device| Edge
```

## Sequence Diagram

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Sched as Scheduler
    participant MutGen as Mutation Generator
    participant Sandbox as Isolated Environment
    participant Signer as Crypto Signer
    participant Peer1 as Neighbor Node B
    participant Peer2 as Neighbor Node C
    participant Trust as Trust Aggregator
    participant QC as Quarantine Controller

    Sched->>MutGen: Trigger periodic mutation cycle
    MutGen->>Sandbox: Deploy auth bypass mutation
    Sandbox-->>MutGen: Mutation detected
    MutGen->>Sandbox: Deploy cert validation failure
    Sandbox-->>MutGen: Mutation detected
    MutGen->>Sandbox: Deploy privilege escalation
    Sandbox-->>MutGen: Mutation detected
    MutGen->>Signer: Submit detection results
    Signer->>Peer1: Broadcast signed report
    Signer->>Peer2: Broadcast signed report
    Peer1->>Trust: Forward own signed report
    Peer2->>Trust: Forward own signed report
    Trust->>Trust: Compute fleet trust scores
    alt All mutations detected
        Trust-->>Sched: Device healthy
    else Missing detections
        Trust->>QC: Flag anomaly
        QC->>QC: Evaluate compromise indicators
        QC-->>Sched: Quarantine device
    end
```

## Trust Score State Diagram

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Initializing
    Initializing --> Trusted: First mutation cycle passes
    Trusted --> Trusted: All mutations detected on schedule
    Trusted --> Degraded: Partial mutation detection failure
    Degraded --> Trusted: Subsequent cycle fully passes
    Degraded --> Suspect: Repeated partial failures
    Suspect --> Quarantined: Neighbor consensus confirms anomaly
    Suspect --> Degraded: Single cycle recovers
    Quarantined --> Investigating: Admin review triggered
    Investigating --> Trusted: Device cleared and policies updated
    Investigating --> Decommissioned: Confirmed compromise
    Trusted --> Suspect: Mutation reports stop arriving
    Decommissioned --> [*]
```

## Fleet Topology and Trust Flow

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Zone1["Zone Alpha"]
        A1[Edge A - Trusted]
        A2[Edge B - Trusted]
        A3[Edge C - Degraded]
    end
    subgraph Zone2["Zone Beta"]
        B1[Edge D - Trusted]
        B2[Edge E - Suspect]
        B3[Edge F - Trusted]
    end
    subgraph Control["Fleet Control Plane"]
        TS[Trust Score Registry]
        QE[Quarantine Engine]
        PM[Policy Manager]
    end
    A1 <-->|Signed Reports| A2
    A2 <-->|Signed Reports| A3
    A1 <-->|Signed Reports| A3
    B1 <-->|Signed Reports| B2
    B2 <-->|Signed Reports| B3
    B1 <-->|Signed Reports| B3
    A1 --> TS
    A2 --> TS
    A3 --> TS
    B1 --> TS
    B2 --> TS
    B3 --> TS
    TS --> QE
    QE -->|Isolate Edge E| B2
    PM -->|Update Mutation Sets| Zone1
    PM -->|Update Mutation Sets| Zone2
```

They break many renderers and image export. - Use shorter labels, multiple nodes, or subgraphs instead of forcing line breaks inside one label. INVENTION: --- invention-id: invention-20260710-102315 company: RedHat created: 2026-07-10T10:23:17 --- # Invention Idea Rather than only mutation testing software during CI/CD, each edge device periodically executes a small set of security-focused mutations (authentication bypasses, certificate validation failures, privilege escalation paths, API tampering) against itself in an isolated execution environment. The results are cryptographically signed and shared with neighboring edge nodes, which build a collective trust score for the fleet. Devices that suddenly stop detecting expected mutations may indicate compromise, stale security policies, or tampering, allowing autonomous quarantine before an exploit succeeds. OUTPUT: ## System Architecture `mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Input[Data Sources] A[Source A] B[Source B] end subgraph Process[Processing] C[Tracker] D[Detector] end subgraph Output[Results] E[Clean Data] F[Alerts] end A --> C B --> C C --> D D --> E D --> F ` ## Sequence Diagram `mermaid sequenceDiagram participant S as Source participant T as Tracker participant D as Detector participant Sys as System S->>T: Submit Data T->>D: Validate D->>Sys: Forward or Block ` Create diagrams specific to THIS invention.
